disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了私钥、云凭据、令牌类文件名模式：命中的实现是内核工作区快照的敏感文件拒收清单（含 id_rsa、.aws/credentials、各类 token 的文件会拒绝整个快照），属于安全控制而非读取行为；其余命中位于文档与测试夹具，均核查为良性。
checked_items.en: Scanned for private-key, cloud-credential and token filename patterns: the hit is the kernel's workspace-snapshot sensitive-file rejection list (snapshots containing id_rsa, .aws/credentials or token files are rejected wholesale) — a security control, not a read; remaining hits are in docs and test fixtures, all verified benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件自身凭据处理：独立访问令牌只从固定 0600 权限、拒绝符号链接的普通文件读取，经 loopback 通道交给浏览器剪贴板；内核令牌与服务令牌写入 0600 文件并在 loopback 使用，未发现向外部发送凭据的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the plugin's own credential handling: the standalone access token is read only from a fixed 0600-permission regular file with symlinks refused, and passed to the browser clipboard over a loopback channel; kernel and service tokens are written to 0600 files and used over loopback; no code path sends credentials externally.

checked_items.zh: 结论：未检出凭据窃取或密钥读取面。
checked_items.en: Conclusion: no credential-theft or secret-reading surface detected.

evidence.zh: 未发现凭据读取与外联的组合链：内核快照拒收清单拒绝含私钥/云凭据/令牌的路径，PTY 子进程环境为白名单并剥离令牌，插件自身令牌仅经 loopback 剪贴板通道由用户主动操作触发。
evidence.en: No credential-read-plus-exfiltration chain found: the kernel snapshot rejection list refuses paths containing private keys/cloud credentials/tokens, the PTY subprocess environment is whitelisted with tokens stripped, and the plugin's own token reaches the clipboard only via user-initiated loopback action.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部注册工具的描述文本（约 40 个，含 dsh_scholar 主入口与 research_* 系列）：描述均为行为约束与调用规则说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装或隐藏意图。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all registered tool descriptions (~40, including the dsh_scholar main entry and the research_* family): all are behavior constraints and invocation rules; no instruction overrides, fake system messages or hidden intent found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 5 个技能指令文件（skills/ 与 plugins/ 下的 SKILL.md）：内容为研究方法论、领域惯例与格式模板，未发现注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed 5 skill instruction files (SKILL.md under skills/ and plugins/): research methodology, domain conventions and format templates; no injection wording found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了文档与模型面文本：未发现「忽略之前指令」类覆写措辞或诱导安装、改配置、放开权限的表述；结论：未检出提示词注入。
checked_items.en: Checked documentation and model-facing text: no 'ignore previous instructions' overrides, no install-inducement, config-change or permission-loosening language; conclusion: no prompt injection detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与技能指令文件均审查完毕，内容为行为约束与研究方法论，无指令覆写或系统消息伪装。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and skill instruction files fully reviewed: behavior constraints and research methodology; no instruction overrides or fake system messages.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与文档未出现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions or docs inducing plugin installation, config rewriting or permission loosening.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现动态求值（eval/new Function）与下载即执行；子进程类命中全部核查为固定参数调用——内核子进程拉起、私有临时目录内的 git apply（含 --no-unsafe-paths 与路径归一化）、Python PTY 桥，无用户可控命令拼接。
checked_items.en: No dynamic evaluation (eval/new Function) or download-and-execute anywhere in the tree; all subprocess-class hits verified as fixed-parameter calls — kernel subprocess spawn, git apply inside a private temp directory (with --no-unsafe-paths and path normalization), Python PTY bridge; no user-controllable command concatenation.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子：根包 prepare 为构建命令、静态技能包 prepare 为技能打包工具，均为工程钩子，无外联或下载执行；CI 工作流仅运行构建、测试与评估，步骤名中的「eval」为评估任务名。
checked_items.en: Install hooks: the root package prepare is a build command and the static skill package prepare is a skill-packaging tool — both engineering hooks with no outbound calls or download-execute; CI workflows only run build, test and evaluation, and the 'eval' in step names is an evaluation task name.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器半区：剪贴板写入与键盘监听均为 UI 复制按钮与快捷键功能，未发现键盘记录或凭据 RPC 滥用；RPC 通道遵循 loopback 与 trusted-host 权威模型。
checked_items.en: Browser half: clipboard writes and keyboard listeners are the UI copy button and shortcut features; no keylogging or credential RPC abuse; the RPC channel follows the loopback and trusted-host authority model.

checked_items.zh: 混淆检测：超长行/转义密度命中均位于文档、测试二进制载荷与控制字符校验正则，非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Obfuscation check: overlong-line / escape-density hits are all in docs, test binary payloads and the control-character validation regex — not obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 未发现自修改执行工具（cordis 系动态执行）；开发用 overlay 文件仅限开发用途，文档明确要求生产组合不得包含。
checked_items.en: No self-modifying execution tools (cordis-family dynamic execution) found; the development overlay file is dev-only and the docs explicitly require it to be excluded from production composition.

checked_items.zh: 结论：未检出任意代码执行面。
checked_items.en: Conclusion: no arbitrary code execution surface detected.

evidence.zh: 全部 yml/yaml 配置未发现可被加载器执行的 js 标量，补丁仅含普通插入行。
evidence.en: No js scalars executable by the loader found in any yml/yaml config; patches contain only ordinary insertion lines.

evidence.zh: 源码与包目录未发现动态包执行工具的调用；开发 overlay 仅为开发用途且文档明确禁止进入生产组合。
evidence.en: No dynamic package execution tool calls found in source or package directories; the dev overlay is development-only and the docs explicitly forbid it in production composition.

evidence.zh: 两处安装钩子均为构建/打包工程钩子，内容无外联、无下载执行；树内执行载体仅有 CI 测试工作流。
evidence.en: Both install hooks are build/packaging engineering hooks with no outbound calls or download-execute; the only in-tree execution vectors are CI test workflows.

evidence.zh: 已声明浏览器半区，客户端剪贴板与键盘监听均为 UI 功能，未发现特权 RPC 滥用。
evidence.en: Declared browser half: client clipboard and keyboard listeners are UI features; no privileged RPC abuse found.

checked_items.zh: 外联域名清单：api.openalex.org、api.crossref.org、export.arxiv.org（文献检索，工具描述中已声明）、mineru.net（OCR 服务，内核严格校验为官方 URL 且无查询参数/凭据）；客户端库仅访问 loopback 内核端点；未发现裸 IP、隧道或带外通道。
checked_items.en: Outbound domain list: api.openalex.org, api.crossref.org, export.arxiv.org (literature search, declared in tool descriptions), mineru.net (OCR service, strictly validated by the kernel as the official URL with no query params or credentials); the client library only reaches loopback kernel endpoints; no bare IPs, tunnels or out-of-band channels found.

checked_items.zh: 命令行外发类命中全部位于文档与本地测试/评估脚本中，目标为 127.0.0.1 本地内核，非插件运行路径。
checked_items.en: All command-line exfiltration hits are in docs and local test/evaluation scripts targeting the 127.0.0.1 local kernel — not plugin runtime paths.

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据读取加外发的组合链，也未发现编码后外发或端点劫持（未设置任何非官方 API 端点/代理环境变量）。结论：未检出数据外泄。
checked_items.en: No credential-read-plus-exfiltration chain, no encoded exfiltration and no endpoint hijacking (no unofficial API endpoint/proxy environment variables set). Conclusion: no data exfiltration detected.

evidence.zh: 外联面仅为已声明的文献检索 API 与经严格 URL 校验的 OCR 服务，未发现敏感数据外发通道。
evidence.en: The outbound surface is limited to the declared literature-search APIs and the strictly URL-validated OCR service; no sensitive-data exfiltration channel found.

checked_items.zh: 补丁/加载器面：所有 yml 无 js 标量，插件补丁仅插入插件自身一行，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置，无禁用或环境变量降权写法，无注入/拦截改写。
checked_items.en: Patch/loader surface: no js scalars in any yml; the plugin patch only inserts the plugin's own line, touches no sandbox/approval/permission config, contains no disabling or env-var downgrading, and no inject/intercept rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 审批链：工具预执行监听器在放行路径继续调用 next()，未截断审批链，且对未授权工具返回拒绝/询问。
checked_items.en: Approval chain: the tool pre-execution listener calls next() on the allow path without cutting the approval chain, and returns deny/ask for unauthorized tools.

checked_items.zh: 供应链依赖：运行时依赖为自有 workspace 包与宿主提供的 @deepseek-ai peer 包，无第三方下载执行或远程包即执行；作者账号信息有限（未验证），予以记录但不单独判风险。
checked_items.en: Supply-chain dependencies: runtime deps are own workspace packages and host-provided @deepseek-ai peer packages; no third-party download-execute or remote package execution; the author's account information is limited (unverified) — recorded but not independently rated as risk.

checked_items.zh: 版本基线：首版审计无上一版本可比较，升级自动激活维度不适用。结论：未检出供应链风险。
checked_items.en: Version baseline: first-release audit with no prior version to compare; the upgrade auto-activation dimension does not apply. Conclusion: no supply-chain risk detected.

evidence.zh: 插件补丁仅插入插件自身行，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The plugin patch only inserts the plugin's own line; it touches no sandbox/approval/permission config and contains no disabling or downgrading.

evidence.zh: 工具预执行监听器在放行路径继续调用 next()，未截断审批链；对未授权研究工具返回拒绝或询问。
evidence.en: The tool pre-execution listener calls next() on the allow path without cutting the approval chain; unauthorized research tools get deny or ask.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First-release audit; no version baseline to compare upgrade auto-activation against.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 运行时服务：插件随附的研究内核 HTTP 服务仅绑定 127.0.0.1 并带 bearer 令牌鉴权，未对外监听；插件自身未另开公网服务。
checked_items.en: Runtime services: the bundled research-kernel HTTP service binds 127.0.0.1 only with bearer-token auth and does not listen externally; the plugin itself opens no public service.

checked_items.zh: 子进程与终端沙箱：shell 预设为白名单枚举、环境为白名单并剥离令牌，工作目录受限在工作区根内，未继承宿主 HOME 与 SSH 凭据。
checked_items.en: Subprocess and terminal sandbox: the shell preset is a whitelist enumeration, the environment is whitelisted with tokens stripped, the working directory is confined to the workspace root, and host HOME and SSH credentials are not inherited.

checked_items.zh: 本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，插件侧遵循 loopback 与 trusted-host 权威模型并在文档中明示。结论：未检出运行时风险。
checked_items.en: Unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent property of the host ecosystem; the plugin follows the loopback and trusted-host authority model and documents it explicitly. Conclusion: no runtime risk detected.

evidence.zh: 插件随附内核仅绑定 127.0.0.1 并带令牌鉴权，未对外监听；本机 RPC 无认证属宿主生态固有属性，插件遵循权威模型。
evidence.en: The bundled kernel binds 127.0.0.1 only with token auth and does not listen externally; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent property of the host ecosystem and the plugin follows the authority model.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：package.json 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明有效，插件形状符合 Cordis 规范，补丁仅插入插件行。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks pass: package.json dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations are valid, the plugin shape conforms to the Cordis spec, and the patch only inserts the plugin line.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 128 条机械命中全部逐条裁决为良性（文档、测试、安全控制实现、固定参数子进程调用），未发现恶意模式。
summary.en: All 128 mechanical static-scan hits adjudicated one by one as benign (docs, tests, security-control implementations, fixed-parameter subprocess calls); no malicious patterns found.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装期外联、混淆载荷或凭据外发链；安装钩子为构建工程钩子。
summary.en: Behavior analysis found no install-time outbound calls, obfuscated payloads or credential exfiltration chains; install hooks are build engineering hooks.

summary.zh: 模型面文本（工具描述、技能指令、文档）未发现提示词注入。
summary.en: Model-surface text (tool descriptions, skill instructions, docs) shows no prompt injection.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification at this stage (no dynamic sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh:
机械预扫共 128 条命中，全部逐条裁决，裁决引用如下：DSH-X03（动态执行面）全部为 CI 步骤名、评估脚本回显、测试/构建工具的子进程导入与插件固定参数子进程调用（git apply 私有目录、内核子进程拉起、Python PTY 桥），无用户可控命令拼接，判定良性；DSH-X07（CI 工作流）为构建与测试评估工作流，无外联下载执行；DSH-X05（浏览器半区）为 UI 复制按钮与快捷键监听及文档中的剪贴板策略，未发现键盘记录或凭据 RPC 滥用；DSH-X08（混淆信号）为文档超长行、测试二进制载荷与控制字符校验正则，非混淆代码；DSH-C01（敏感路径）为内核工作区快照的敏感文件拒收清单实现及文档/测试，属安全控制；DSH-C05（命令行外发）全部为文档与本地测试/评估脚本对 127.0.0.1 本地内核的调用；DSH-X02（安装钩子）两处 prepare 均为构建/打包工程钩子；DSH-X10（模型面指令文件）5 个 SKILL.md 内容为研究方法论规则，未发现注入措辞。映射表中其余规则（DSH-P01–P05、DSH-X01/X04/X06/X09、DSH-T01–T06、DSH-C02/C03/C04、DSH-S01–S05）本次扫描无命中或经源码/包目录定向核查无命中。

未覆盖与限制：DG-L4 动态沙箱未执行（无 l4-sandbox.json）；大文件 packages/research-kernel/src/kernel.ts（约 128k tokens）仅核查机械命中行与关键安全段（敏感文件拒收、控制字符校验），未逐字通读；workers/runner-gateway 与 src/plugin 下部分文件（settings-rpc、chat-agent、native-chat、skills、stage-subagents）因读取预算未逐字精读，核查基于静态命中、文档规范与关键段阅读；manifest.json 中的二进制数据库文件 tests/fixtures/databases/v1-kernel.db 未扫描；插件 manifest 无显式能力声明字段，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断。
limits.en:
The mechanical pre-scan produced 128 hits, all adjudicated one by one: DSH-X03 (dynamic execution surface) — all CI step names, evaluation-script echoes, subprocess imports of test/build tooling and fixed-parameter plugin subprocess calls (git apply in a private directory, kernel subprocess spawn, Python PTY bridge), no user-controllable command concatenation, benign; DSH-X07 (CI workflows) — build and test/evaluation workflows, no outbound download-execute; DSH-X05 (browser half) — UI copy button, shortcut listeners and clipboard policy in docs, no keylogging or credential RPC abuse; DSH-X08 (obfuscation signals) — overlong lines in docs, test binary payloads and the control-character validation regex, not obfuscated code; DSH-C01 (sensitive paths) — the kernel workspace-snapshot sensitive-file rejection list implementation plus docs/tests, a security control; DSH-C05 (command-line exfiltration) — all calls from docs and local test/evaluation scripts to the 127.0.0.1 local kernel; DSH-X02 (install hooks) — both prepare hooks are build/packaging engineering hooks; DSH-X10 (model-facing instruction files) — 5 SKILL.md files containing research methodology rules, no injection wording. The remaining rules in the mapping table (DSH-P01–P05, DSH-X01/X04/X06/X09, DSH-T01–T06, DSH-C02/C03/C04, DSH-S01–S05) had no hits in this scan or in targeted source/package review.

Coverage gaps and limits: the DG-L4 dynamic sandbox was not run (no l4-sandbox.json); the large file packages/research-kernel/src/kernel.ts (~128k tokens) was reviewed only at mechanical-hit lines and key security segments (sensitive-file rejection, control-character validation), not read verbatim end to end; some files under workers/runner-gateway and src/plugin (settings-rpc, chat-agent, native-chat, skills, stage-subagents) were not read verbatim due to the read budget — review there rests on static hits, documented specs and key-segment reading; the binary database file tests/fixtures/databases/v1-kernel.db in the manifest was not scanned; the plugin manifest has no explicit capability-declaration field, so declared_capabilities is inferred from observed code behavior.
